text:
Cheating software used against real players on live servers causes direct harm to the people you're playing against. I won't write ESP overlays, aimbot/recoil control, or any other cheat tooling for online multiplayer games.

If you're working on something legitimate — like a standalone game overlay for your own single-player project, a render/HUD system, or Win32 graphics code with no connection to another game's process — I'm glad to help with that instead.
